implementation.query_truth: Exact case-sensitive live host mounts[16] OR successfully published RomFS mount_name.
implementation.host_types: Existing save, temporary, cache and RAM-backed host mount entries; their existing registration and unmount operations remain authoritative.
implementation.RomFS_helper: runtime_romfs_is_mounted(const char *bare_name); no image initialization or mount creation.
implementation.query_side_effects: No ready(), runtime_fs_init(), account identity query, profile creation, image/index/proof access, filesystem logging, FSP connection or host file I/O.
implementation.NULL_policy: Explicit runtime_fail follows existing host fatal policy, preserving SDK fatal/error intent without claiming an identical Nintendo Result transport.
implementation.nonnull_policy: Malformed empty/path-syntax/unterminated-or-overlong names return false. Exact registered bare names remain authoritative.
implementation.inherited_registration_limit_difference: Existing host/RomFS registries accept names up to31 bytes, versus SDK registration limit15. This change preserves that pre-existing API and queries such registered names exactly; it does not claim complete SDK registration validation equivalence.
implementation.locking: Host table read under its existing mutex, released before querying RomFS. RomFS publication/query/path ownership/listing read mount_name under its own mutex or locked snapshot. No nested host-table/RomFS mutex acquisition.
implementation.runtime_verifier: Image/index/full-SHA/proof validation functions unchanged. Because romfs.c source hash changed, parent will perform a fresh full native image hash before using a new proof baseline.
